cli-unknown-command.cause: The command is not in the CLI dispatch table.
cli-unknown-command.fix: Run `nexuspanel help` to list valid commands.

cli-root-required.error: Root is required. Run: sudo npm run service:install

cli-systemd-missing.error: Systemd is required for VPS background service mode.

cli-no-owner-interactive.error: No owner account exists. Run nexuspanel start in an interactive terminal or set NEXUSPANEL_OWNER_EMAIL and NEXUSPANEL_OWNER_PASSWORD.
cli-no-owner-interactive.cause: First-run owner creation needs interactive input.
cli-no-owner-interactive.fix: Set NEXUSPANEL_OWNER_EMAIL + NEXUSPANEL_OWNER_PASSWORD, or run interactively.

cli-setup-already-done.cause: A user already exists in the database.
cli-setup-already-done.fix: Sign in normally; the setup URL is single-use.

cli-port-invalid.error: Panel port must be between 1 and 65535.

cli-service-not-active.error: nexuspanel did not become active. Run: journalctl -u nexuspanel -n 100 --no-pager
cli-service-not-active.fix: Read the journal, fix the reported error, restart.

perm-not-authenticated.error: Your session expired. Sign in again.
perm-not-authenticated.cause: No valid session cookie, or the session expired/idle-timed-out.

perm-insufficient-capability.error: This account does not have that permission.
perm-insufficient-capability.cause: The admin's permissions_json does not include the required capability.
perm-insufficient-capability.fix: Owner grants the capability in Admins, or raises access_level.

perm-owner-only.cause: The route is hard-gated to role=owner.

perm-server-not-found.cause: The server does not exist OR the admin does not own it (deliberate ambiguity to prevent enumeration).
perm-server-not-found.fix: Verify the server id and that the account owns it.

perm-owner-cannot-be-edited.error: Owner account cannot be edited by another user.
perm-owner-cannot-be-edited.cause: A non-owner tried to PATCH the owner.
perm-owner-cannot-be-edited.fix: Only the owner can edit their own account.

perm-owner-cannot-be-deleted.fix: Transfer ownership first (not supported); keep the owner account.

perm-assign-all-owner-only.error: Only the owner can assign every server.
perm-assign-all-owner-only.fix: Assign servers individually, or ask the owner.

perm-invalid-assigned-user.error: Assign servers to a valid admin user, or leave unassigned for owner-only.
perm-invalid-assigned-user.cause: resolveServerOwnerUserId got a non-existent id or the owner id.
perm-invalid-assigned-user.fix: Pick an existing admin user id.

perm-grant-escalation-blocked.cause: A non-owner tried to grant a capability they do not hold.
perm-grant-escalation-blocked.fix: Only grant capabilities you already have.

asf-landlock-unavailable.error: [ASF] Landlock is unavailable on this kernel: <errno>
asf-landlock-unavailable.cause: Kernel < 5.13 or Landlock disabled at boot.
asf-landlock-unavailable.fix: Upgrade to Linux 5.13+ (Ubuntu 22.04+). Panel falls back to systemd isolation.

asf-landlock-abi-too-low.cause: Kernel older than 6.2 (ABI 3 needed for truncate blocking).
asf-landlock-abi-too-low.fix: Upgrade kernel, or the panel auto-selects the 'core' tier.

asf-ruleset-create-failed.cause: seccomp/LSM policy conflict or missing CAP_SYS_ADMIN.
asf-ruleset-create-failed.fix: Check `dmesg` for LSM denials; ensure the panel runs as root.

asf-path-open-failed.cause: A required read-only path is missing on this distro.
asf-path-open-failed.fix: Usually harmless (non-required paths are skipped). If fatal, install the missing package.

asf-net-port-rule-failed.fix: Panel retries with the 'core' tier automatically.

asf-no-new-privs-failed.cause: prctl blocked (rare; nested container without privileges).
asf-no-new-privs-failed.fix: Run the panel outside an unprivileged container.

asf-seccomp-install-failed.cause: seccomp already restricted by an outer sandbox.
asf-seccomp-install-failed.fix: Relax the outer sandbox, or accept the systemd fallback.

asf-invalid-port.fix: Panel bug; report it. Port comes from the server row.

asf-pdeathsig-failed.error: [ASF] cannot bind workload lifetime to supervisor
asf-pdeathsig-failed.cause: Parent died between fork and prctl.
asf-pdeathsig-failed.fix: Transient; the panel restarts the server.

asf-invalid-root.cause: realpath() failed — root missing or unreadable.
asf-invalid-root.fix: Recreate the server folder or run Repair & Diagnose.

asf-root-not-directory.error: [ASF] server root is not a directory
asf-root-not-directory.fix: Fix server_path in the database or recreate the server.

asf-chdir-failed.cause: Missing execute permission on the root.

asf-uid-gid-mismatch.error: [ASF] both isolated uid and gid are required

asf-setresuid-failed.cause: setresuid/setresgid failed — usually the identity user was deleted.
asf-setresuid-failed.fix: Delete and recreate the server, or re-run the ASF doctor.

asf-identity-verify-failed.cause: getresuid/getresgid did not match the target after the drop.
asf-identity-verify-failed.fix: Kernel/container quirk; the panel retries with compatibility isolation.

asf-root-too-long.fix: Shorten the server name / move the install to a shorter path.

asf-exec-not-found.error: [ASF] cannot execute <path>: No such file or directory

asf-exec-not-executable.cause: Missing execute bit or a noexec mount.
asf-exec-not-executable.fix: Reinstall software, or remount without noexec.

auth-invalid-credentials.cause: Email not found OR password mismatch (deliberately identical).
auth-invalid-credentials.fix: Check credentials. After 5 failures the account throttles.

auth-throttled.error: Too many login attempts. Try again in <n> seconds.
auth-throttled.cause: 5 account failures or 10 IP failures within 15 minutes.
auth-throttled.fix: Wait for the backoff window (exponential, capped at 1 hour).

auth-session-expired.error: Your session expired. Sign in again.

auth-user-agent-mismatch.cause: Cookie stolen and replayed from a different browser.
auth-user-agent-mismatch.fix: Sign in again; the stolen cookie is now dead.

auth-account-expired.fix: Owner recreates the admin with a new expiry.

auth-setup-token-invalid.fix: Run `nexuspanel setup-url` for a fresh link.

auth-setup-already-complete.error: Initial setup has already been completed.

auth-name-invalid.error: Name must be between 2 and 100 characters.

auth-password-too-short.error: Password must be between 12 and 256 characters.

auth-email-taken.error: That email address is already registered.
auth-email-taken.fix: Use a different email or sign in.

auth-otp-expired.error: OTP expired. Request a new code.

auth-otp-too-many-attempts.error: Too many OTP attempts. Request a new code.

auth-otp-rate-limited.error: Wait one minute before requesting another code.

auth-otp-delivery-failed.error: Email delivery failed. Owner can read data/password-reset-otp.log on the VPS.

auth-csrf-blocked.cause: Missing x-nexuspanel-request: 1 header on a mutating request.
auth-csrf-blocked.fix: Use the panel UI; direct API calls must send the header.

auth-cross-site-blocked.cause: Sec-Fetch-Site header indicates a cross-site origin.

auth-host-maintenance.error: Host maintenance is active. Only the panel owner can sign in.

perm-runtime-protected.cause: A file operation targeted the `runtime/` folder.
perm-runtime-protected.fix: Runtime files are managed by the installer; do not edit them.

perm-metadata-protected.error: NexusPanel metadata files are protected. Resource limits are enforced from the database, not editable server files.
perm-metadata-protected.fix: Change limits in the server settings, not in files.

perm-symlink-blocked.error: Symlinks are blocked in the server file manager.
perm-symlink-blocked.cause: A path component is a symlink (escape attempt).
perm-symlink-blocked.fix: Use real paths inside the server root.

perm-root-symlink-blocked.cause: The server root itself is a symlink.
perm-root-symlink-blocked.fix: Recreate the server folder as a real directory.

perm-path-escapes-storage.cause: assertInside detected `..` traversal or an absolute path outside the root.
perm-path-escapes-storage.fix: Use a relative path inside the server root.

perm-plugin-name-invalid.error: Plugin file name must be a plain file name.
perm-plugin-name-invalid.cause: The plugin filename contained a path separator.
perm-plugin-name-invalid.fix: Provide just the filename, e.g. MyPlugin.jar.

server-software-incompatible.error: Selected software is not compatible with this server type.
server-software-incompatible.cause: Java software chosen for a Bedrock server (or vice versa).
server-software-incompatible.fix: Pick software matching the server edition.

server-already-running.cause: startServer called while the process is live.

server-not-installed.cause: executable_path missing or the file does not exist.
server-not-installed.fix: Install software from the Software tab.

server-eula-required.error: Agree to the Minecraft EULA first.
server-eula-required.fix: Accept the EULA in the panel.

server-no-runtime.error: This Nexu template needs an installer/runtime before it can start.
server-no-runtime.fix: Run the template installer (owner + full access).

server-stop-before-delete.error: Stop the server before deleting it.

server-stop-before-port-change.error: Stop the server before changing its game port.
server-stop-before-port-change.fix: Stop the server, change the port, restart.

server-port-invalid.error: Server port must be an integer between 1024 and 65535.

server-port-verify-failed.cause: server.properties write did not persist the port.
server-port-verify-failed.fix: Check file permissions; run Repair & Diagnose.

server-port-profile-rollback.error: Port changed in database but ASF profile regeneration failed; change was rolled back.
server-port-profile-rollback.cause: writeProfile threw after the DB update.

server-whitelist-java-format.error: Java usernames must be 3-16 letters, numbers, or underscores.

server-world-convert-same-edition.error: Choose the opposite edition for conversion.

server-world-convert-online.error: Stop the source server before converting its world.

server-converter-missing.error: Chunker CLI is not installed. Install the converter first.
server-converter-missing.fix: Install the world converter from Settings.

server-converter-no-jar.error: No Chunker CLI jar was found in the latest GitHub release. Download the CLI jar manually into data/tools/chunker-cli.jar.

server-converter-release-failed.cause: GitHub API rate limit or network issue.

server-properties-unreadable.fix: The panel rebuilds it automatically and restarts.

server-restart-storm.cause: The server crashes immediately on every start.
server-restart-storm.fix: Run Repair & Diagnose, then start manually.

server-launch-failed.cause: The process died before becoming healthy.
server-launch-failed.fix: Check the console log for the real error.

server-memory-guard-stop.cause: RSS exceeded the allocation guard limit.
server-memory-guard-stop.fix: Increase RAM allocation or pre-generate the world.

server-allocation-guard.cause: Sustained memory overuse triggered the guard.

server-properties-recovery.fix: Automatic; the panel rebuilds and restarts.

server-quota-exceeded.cause: host_server_quota limit hit in host edition.

install-version-resolve-failed.error: Could not resolve a downloadable version for <software>.
install-version-resolve-failed.cause: Upstream API (PaperMC/Mojang/Fabric) unreachable or version invalid.
install-version-resolve-failed.fix: Check network, retry, or pick a different version.

install-download-404.cause: The selected version was removed upstream.

install-download-failed.fix: Retry; the panel retries 3 times automatically.

install-jar-invalid.error: <software> download is not a valid jar. Recheck the selected version and retry.
install-jar-invalid.cause: The file is not a ZIP (jar) — wrong URL or HTML error page.

install-jar-missing.error: <software> download did not create a jar file.
install-jar-missing.cause: The download path was not written.

install-forge-no-args.error: Forge installer finished but no launch args or Forge jar was found.
install-forge-no-args.fix: Check the install log; retry with a different Forge version.

install-forge-installer-failed.cause: Java version mismatch or corrupt download.
install-forge-installer-failed.fix: Install the correct Java version, retry.

install-bedrock-no-binary.error: Bedrock archive extracted but server executable was not found.

install-pocketmine-invalid-phar.error: PocketMine file is not a valid PHAR. Reinstall PocketMine from the Software tab.

install-pocketmine-php-missing.error: PocketMine bundled PHP is missing or broken. Reinstall PocketMine from the Software tab.

install-pocketmine-php-asset-missing.error: No compatible asset found in pmmp/PHP-Binaries latest release.

install-nexu-no-commands.error: This Nexu template has no installer commands.
install-nexu-no-commands.fix: Edit the template or use a standard software.

install-nexu-executable-missing.error: Nexu install finished but executable was not found: <path>
install-nexu-executable-missing.cause: The installer did not produce the expected binary.
install-nexu-executable-missing.fix: Check the install log; fix the template's executable path.

install-nexu-owner-required.error: Only the owner can run Nexu template installer commands.
install-nexu-owner-required.cause: Nexu installers run arbitrary shell; gated to owner.

install-nexu-full-access-required.error: Unlock time-limited owner full access before running Nexu installer commands.
install-nexu-full-access-required.fix: Unlock full access in Security, then retry.

install-steamcmd-missing.cause: steamcmd not installed for a steamcmd-mode template.

install-java-required.error: <software> <version> requires Java <n>, but this VPS is running Java <m>.
install-java-required.cause: Java too old for the Minecraft version.
install-java-required.fix: Install Java <n>+ or pick an older Minecraft version.

install-java-not-found.error: Java runtime was not found in PATH. Install Java 21+ (Linux: apt install -y openjdk-21-jre-headless) then restart the server.

install-bundled-java-broken.cause: The bundled runtime lost its execute bit or is on a noexec mount.
install-bundled-java-broken.fix: Reinstall software, or remount without noexec.

install-disk-full.error: ENOSPC: no space left on device

install-permission-denied.cause: The panel user cannot write the server root.

install-progress-stuck.cause: The install promise rejected without updating status.

java-missing.error: Java runtime was not found in PATH.

java-too-old.error: requires Java <n>, but this VPS is running Java <m>.

java-runtime-missing.error: The bundled Java runtime for this server is missing.
java-runtime-missing.cause: The bundled java binary does not exist.
java-runtime-missing.fix: Restore the server-scoped bundled Java runtime with Repair & Diagnose.

java-heap-capped.cause: Normal — the panel reserves ~15% for JVM overhead.

file-path-required.error: Choose a file path inside the server folder.

file-preview-signature-mismatch.error: File signature does not match its extension.
file-preview-signature-mismatch.cause: Magic bytes do not match the claimed type (spoofing attempt).
file-preview-signature-mismatch.fix: Rename the file to its real type.

file-upload-chunk-not-binary.error: Upload chunk body must be binary.

file-upload-size-invalid.fix: Send a total size >= the chunk length.

file-upload-too-large.error: Upload exceeds the configured size limit.
file-upload-too-large.fix: Raise the env var or split the file.

file-upload-chunk-hash-mismatch.error: Chunk checksum mismatch. Retrying this chunk is safe.

file-upload-final-hash-mismatch.error: Final file checksum mismatch. Retry the upload.

file-upload-size-mismatch.error: Upload size mismatch. Retry the file.

file-upload-missing-chunks.error: Upload has missing chunks. Reselect the same file to resume.

file-upload-session-missing.error: Upload session file was not found.

file-archive-root-blocked.error: Cannot archive the server root directly. Select files or folders inside it.

file-extract-not-zip.error: Select one or more .zip files to unzip.

file-extract-invalid-zip.error: <path> is not a complete valid ZIP. It may be an unfinished upload/download. Re-upload it or use a fresh backup/archive.

file-extract-protected-entry.error: Archive contains protected NexusPanel metadata/runtime path: <entry>
file-extract-protected-entry.cause: The zip contains runtime/ or metadata paths.

file-extract-zip-slip.error: Archive entry escapes the extraction folder and was blocked: <entry>
file-extract-zip-slip.cause: Zip Slip attack — an entry with `../` or an absolute path.
file-extract-zip-slip.fix: The archive is malicious; do not extract it.

file-extract-absolute-entry.error: Archive entry uses an absolute path and was blocked: <entry>

file-extract-collisions.error: Extract would replace <n> existing file(s). Choose Replace all or Skip existing.

file-archive-protected.error: Cannot archive protected NexusPanel metadata/runtime path: <entry>

file-unzip-missing.error: unzip is required to extract zip files. Run: apt install -y unzip

file-tar-missing.error: tar is required to extract this archive.

file-archive-write-stopped.error: Archive write stopped before the ZIP was complete.
file-archive-write-stopped.cause: Disk full or I/O error during zip creation.

file-archive-transient.fix: Expected; retry if the archive is incomplete.

file-edit-timeline.cause: Normal — every edit creates a recovery point.

file-upload-40mb-limit.fix: Use chunked upload (the UI does this automatically).

backup-restore-online.error: Stop the server before restoring a backup.

backup-invalid-archive.error: Backup is not a valid ZIP.

backup-public-link-owner-only.error: Only the server owner can publish backup links.
backup-public-link-owner-only.fix: Sign in as the server owner.

backup-public-link-invalid.error: Public backup link is invalid, expired, or revoked.

backup-public-direct-download.error: Direct browser downloads are disabled. Paste this URL into NexusPanel Import Backup.

backup-transfer-header-missing.error: This backup can only be transferred by NexusPanel.

backup-import-url-invalid.error: Enter a valid public backup URL.

backup-import-not-nexuspanel.error: This is not a NexusPanel public backup URL.

backup-import-private-address.error: Backup imports cannot connect to local or private network addresses.
backup-import-private-address.cause: SSRF defense — the host resolves to a private IP.

backup-import-too-large.error: Remote backup is larger than the configured import limit.

backup-import-exceeded.error: Remote backup exceeded the configured import limit.
backup-import-exceeded.cause: Streamed bytes exceeded the limit mid-transfer.

backup-import-not-zip.error: Remote file is not a valid ZIP backup.

backup-share-code-owner-only.error: Only the source server owner can create backup codes.

backup-share-code-hide-owner-only.error: Only the source server owner can hide backup codes.

backup-paused.cause: Crash or launch failure triggered a backup pause.

plugin-incompatible.fix: Match the plugin type to the server software.

plugin-modrinth-unsupported.error: Modrinth install supports Paper/Purpur plugins and Fabric/Forge mods.

plugin-modrinth-no-file.fix: Pick a different project or version.

plugin-poggit-pocketmine-only.error: Poggit plugins can only be installed on PocketMine servers.

plugin-poggit-url-invalid.cause: The URL does not start with https://poggit.pmmp.io/.

asf-build-failed.fix: Install build-essential; check the compiler output.

asf-self-test-failed.cause: The built binary failed its own sandbox self-test.
asf-self-test-failed.fix: Check kernel LSM support; the panel keeps the previous binary.

asf-preflight-storage.fix: Fix permissions on the data directory.

asf-supervisor-failure.cause: systemd reported the unit's failure reason.
asf-supervisor-failure.fix: Read the detail; usually an ASF setup failure.

asf-compatibility-retry.cause: The native sandbox failed within 5 seconds.
asf-compatibility-retry.fix: Automatic; the retry surfaces the real Minecraft error.

asf-cgroup-startup-burst.cause: Servers with ≤3 cores get a 2x startup burst.

asf-throttle-update-failed.fix: Check systemd; the steady limit still applies via the unit.

asf-unit-collected.cause: The transient unit exited before the throttle timer.

asf-identity-unavailable-log.fix: Run as root with acl installed.

service-install-root.error: Root is required. Run: sudo npm run service:install

service-systemd-required.error: Systemd is required for VPS background service mode.

service-not-active.error: nexuspanel did not become active. Run: journalctl -u nexuspanel -n 100 --no-pager

service-restart-failed.error: nexuspanel restart failed. Run: journalctl -u nexuspanel -n 100 --no-pager

service-port-invalid.error: Panel port must be between 1 and 65535.

net-ngrok-not-installed.fix: Install ngrok from the Network tab.

net-ngrok-token-missing.error: Save your ngrok auth token first.

net-playit-not-installed.fix: Install Playit from the Network tab.

net-playit-apt-only.error: Playit one-click install currently supports Ubuntu/Debian apt hosts.

net-playit-claim-owner-only.error: Only the owner can run the Playit claim terminal.

net-tunnels-removed.error: Tunnels were removed. Use Templates or your VPS reverse proxy setup instead.

net-host-edition-tunnels.error: Normal-edition tunnel setup is not available in host edition.

net-ssrf-private.error: Backup imports cannot connect to local or private network addresses.

db-locked.fix: Retry; the panel uses WAL and BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

ai-openrouter-no-key.error: OpenRouter API key is not configured.

ai-openrouter-http-error.fix: Check the key, model, and quota.

ai-openrouter-owner-only.error: Only the owner can configure external AI providers.

ai-openrouter-chat-owner-only.error: Only the owner can use the external AI bridge.

ai-micro-owner-only.error: Only the owner can update the MicroLM.

ai-tool-full-access-required.error: Unlock time-limited AI full access before running a mutating tool.

ai-tool-server-required.error: A server is required for this tool.

ai-tool-owner-only.error: Only the owner can execute advanced AI tools.

ai-tool-read-limit.error: AI text reads are limited to 512 KB files.

ai-tool-write-limit.error: AI writes require a path and are limited to 512 KB.
ai-tool-write-limit.fix: Provide a path and smaller content.

ai-tool-diagnostic-not-allowed.error: Terminal diagnostic command is not allowed: <cmd>
ai-tool-diagnostic-not-allowed.cause: The command is not in the agent_terminal allowlist.

ai-tool-diagnostic-arg-not-allowed.error: Terminal diagnostic argument is not allowed for <cmd>.
ai-tool-diagnostic-arg-not-allowed.cause: The argument failed the per-command regex or contained shell metacharacters.

ai-tool-diagnostic-args-too-long.error: Terminal diagnostic argument list is too long.

ai-tool-diagnostic-path-escape.cause: A path argument resolved outside the server root.
ai-tool-diagnostic-path-escape.fix: Use a path inside the server root.

ai-full-access-owner-only.error: Only the owner can unlock AI full access.

ai-command-queue-owner-only.error: Only the owner can queue host commands.

ai-command-approve-owner-only.error: Only the owner can approve host commands.

ai-repair-web-host-blocked.error: Research source is not an allowed host.

ai-repair-web-private.error: Research source resolves to a private address.

ai-repair-no-safe-fix.fix: Restore a verified backup or remove incompatible world/pack files.

ai-repair-learned-failed.fix: Check the error; the panel falls back to proactive repair.

ai-repair-model-reset.cause: The knowledge base or model version changed.

ai-advanced-install-failed.cause: The @huggingface/transformers package or model download failed.

ui-empty-state-servers.error: No servers yet. Create one from Dashboard or Templates.

ui-empty-state-console.error: No servers yet. Create one above, then install software from the Software tab.

ui-empty-state-plugins-locked.error: Plugin manager is locked until file access level 80.

ui-empty-state-plugins-none.error: No plugins installed for this server yet. Search Modrinth above.

ui-empty-state-modrinth.error: Select Paper/Purpur for plugins or Fabric/Forge for mods.

ui-empty-state-bedrock-packs.error: Bedrock Dedicated Server packs need behavior/resource pack registration. Use File Manager for now; PocketMine plugins are available after switching software.

ui-empty-state-properties.error: Create a server to edit properties.

ui-empty-state-whitelist.error: Create a server to manage whitelist.

ui-empty-state-files.error: Create a server to browse files.

ui-empty-state-folder.error: Folder is empty. Create a file or paste config here.

ui-empty-state-preview.error: Safe inline preview is not available for this format. Download it to open with its native application.

ui-empty-state-backups.error: Create a server to manage backups.

ui-empty-state-shared-backups.error: No shared backups approved for this server.

ui-empty-state-network.error: No network counters available on this OS.

ui-empty-state-fixed-none.error: No fixed events recorded in the last 24 hours.

ui-empty-state-health.error: Run a health check to verify panel folders, database, software, and Java.

ui-terminal-removed.fix: Use the console for server commands.

minecraft-no-server-jar.cause: No Minecraft software build has been installed, or the configured JAR name does not match the installed file.
minecraft-no-server-jar.fix: Recommend choosing and installing a compatible build (Vanilla, Paper, Purpur, Fabric, Forge, or another supported catalog option) in the panel Software section. If a JAR already exists, verify its configured filename and server root before reinstalling.

minecraft-software-install-incomplete.error: Server JAR is missing or the downloaded JAR is zero bytes / truncated.
minecraft-software-install-incomplete.cause: The software download did not finish, or disk/network failure left a partial artifact.
minecraft-software-install-incomplete.fix: Check free disk space and the software install log, remove only the identified partial download, then retry the selected software build from the panel catalog. Do not delete the world or unrelated server files.

minecraft-server-main-class-missing.error: no main manifest attribute, in server.jar
minecraft-server-main-class-missing.cause: A plugin, proxy, client, or unrelated JAR was selected as the server executable.
minecraft-server-main-class-missing.fix: Install a server distribution from the panel Software catalog, or select the correct server JAR. Do not rename an arbitrary JAR to server.jar.

minecraft-eula-not-accepted.error: You need to agree to the EULA in order to run the server
minecraft-eula-not-accepted.cause: Minecraft requires the operator to review and accept its EULA before startup.
minecraft-eula-not-accepted.fix: Show the panel EULA acceptance control and require the operator to make that choice. Do not accept the EULA automatically.

minecraft-plugin-isolate-safely.error: Error occurred while enabling ExamplePlugin; plugin disabled
minecraft-plugin-isolate-safely.cause: The named plugin may be incompatible, misconfigured, missing a dependency, or conflicting with another plugin.
minecraft-plugin-isolate-safely.fix: Identify the first plugin exception and full caused-by stack. Check the plugin's server/API version and declared dependencies. Suggest disabling only the named plugin on an offline backup or staging copy, then compare a controlled boot. Never remove or disable plugins and restart the live server automatically.

minecraft-plugin-java-incompatibility.cause: The plugin requires a newer Java major version, or the server is using an incompatible plugin build.
minecraft-plugin-java-incompatibility.fix: Compare the plugin's documented Java requirement with the selected server runtime. Recommend selecting a compatible Java runtime or plugin build, then verify on a staging copy.

minecraft-plugin-missing-dependency.error: Unknown/missing dependency PluginDependency required by ExamplePlugin
minecraft-plugin-missing-dependency.cause: A required dependency is not installed, is disabled, or its plugin name/version does not satisfy the declaration.
minecraft-plugin-missing-dependency.fix: Show the exact missing dependency and recommend its compatible official release. Verify loader, server version, and dependency ordering; do not download from an untrusted mirror.

minecraft-plugin-api-mismatch.error: Unsupported API version / legacy plugin loading is disabled
minecraft-plugin-api-mismatch.cause: The plugin build targets an API/server version not supported by this server.
minecraft-plugin-api-mismatch.fix: Recommend a plugin release compatible with the current server version, using the project owner's official download page. Avoid editing plugin metadata to bypass compatibility checks.

minecraft-world-corruption-startup.error: Failed to read chunk / region file is corrupt / failed to load level.dat
minecraft-world-corruption-startup.cause: World data may be damaged, or storage returned an I/O error.
minecraft-world-corruption-startup.fix: Keep the server stopped to avoid further writes. Check disk and filesystem health, preserve a copy of the world, and recommend restoring a verified backup or using a game-specific offline repair tool. Never regenerate or overwrite the only world automatically.

minecraft-bind-port-conflict.error: FAILED TO BIND TO PORT / Address already in use
minecraft-bind-port-conflict.cause: Another server process or service owns the port.
minecraft-bind-port-conflict.fix: Identify the owning process and server allocation first. Stop only a confirmed stale process or assign a free port; preserve other live servers.

nexuspanel-asf-wrapper-failed.error: Nexus-Mark native runtime failed / process exited code=200 / ASF wrapper error
nexuspanel-asf-wrapper-failed.cause: The ASF isolation wrapper, host kernel feature, per-server identity, or ACL setup failed before launching the game runtime.
nexuspanel-asf-wrapper-failed.fix: Inspect the panel server log, transient systemd unit journal, and ASF self-test for the same server. Repair the specific host preflight/identity problem. Do not bypass isolation or launch tenant code as root. Retry only after the supported isolation path passes preflight.

nexuspanel-server-runtime-failed.error: Failed to start server process / spawn failed / exit before server ready
nexuspanel-server-runtime-failed.cause: Possible executable, working-directory, permission, Java, startup-flag, isolation, or game configuration error; the supervisor message alone does not identify which.
nexuspanel-server-runtime-failed.fix: Use the first runtime/supervisor error and process exit status to classify the failure. Check the configured executable, server root, runtime selection, and startup flags. Do not infer a Java memory problem without JVM/OOM evidence, and do not enter a restart loop.

minecraft-startup-flags-invalid.error: Unrecognized VM option / Could not create the Java Virtual Machine
minecraft-startup-flags-invalid.cause: A flag is invalid for the selected Java major version, malformed, or conflicts with a panel-managed memory/system property.
minecraft-startup-flags-invalid.fix: Show the exact rejected flag and recommend removing or correcting that flag in Settings > Startup. Keep panel-managed heap and isolation options under panel control; do not silently discard all user flags.

minecraft-plugin-crash-loop.error: Server restart loop after plugin enable failure
minecraft-plugin-crash-loop.cause: A persistent plugin/configuration failure is being retried by a restart policy.
minecraft-plugin-crash-loop.fix: Stop or pause the restart loop, preserve the logs, and isolate the named plugin on an offline copy or staging server. Resume production only after a verified fix; never auto-delete plugin data.

bedrock-binary-permission.cause: The executable bit or a parent directory permission was lost during extraction, or the server identity cannot traverse the path.
bedrock-binary-permission.fix: Verify the binary and parent-directory permissions for the dedicated server identity. Restore execute permission only on the official server binary; do not chmod the full server tree or run it as root.

bedrock-platform-architecture.cause: The selected official package does not match the VPS OS or CPU architecture, or it is an incomplete download.
bedrock-platform-architecture.fix: Check the VPS architecture and supported BDS package platform, then reinstall a matching official build. Do not try to run an x64 binary on ARM through an unsafe compatibility workaround.

bedrock-native-library-missing.error: error while loading shared libraries: lib*.so: cannot open shared object file
bedrock-native-library-missing.cause: The host is missing a runtime library required by that Bedrock build.
bedrock-native-library-missing.fix: Identify the exact missing library and install its supported distribution package (commonly libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, or libc6). Confirm the host distribution and architecture before installing packages.

bedrock-udp-firewall.error: RakNet timeout / UDP port unreachable / no Bedrock response
bedrock-udp-firewall.cause: Bedrock uses UDP; the server allocation, host firewall, provider firewall, or external route may block that UDP port.
bedrock-udp-firewall.fix: Verify the configured Bedrock port and open that UDP port in both host and provider firewalls. Confirm the process is listening and test from outside the VPS. A successful TCP probe does not prove UDP works.

bedrock-pack-engine-version.error: Pack requires a newer engine version / min_engine_version is too high
bedrock-pack-engine-version.cause: The pack targets a newer Bedrock engine than the installed BDS build supports.
bedrock-pack-engine-version.fix: Match the pack release to the installed BDS version or update BDS from the supported software catalog. Preserve the world and pack before making changes; only quarantine an incompatible pack while the server is offline.

bedrock-pack-manifest-invalid-startup.error: manifest.json invalid / missing header UUID / pack manifest parse error
bedrock-pack-manifest-invalid-startup.cause: The pack archive may be incomplete, its manifest JSON is invalid, or required UUID/version fields are absent.
bedrock-pack-manifest-invalid-startup.fix: Validate the named manifest and compare it with the pack's official release. Restore a valid copy or disable only that pack on an offline copy; do not rewrite UUIDs referenced by a live world.

bedrock-allowlist-rejected.error: Player is not whitelisted / allowlist check failed
bedrock-allowlist-rejected.cause: The allowlist may be enabled without the player's current XUID entry, or the allowlist file may not have reloaded.
bedrock-allowlist-rejected.fix: Check the player's Bedrock identity/XUID in the panel allowlist, confirm allowlist is enabled intentionally, and use the server-supported reload or a controlled restart. Do not disable the allowlist as an automatic fix.

bedrock-pocketmine-runtime.error: PocketMine PHP runtime missing / invalid PHAR / required extension unavailable
bedrock-pocketmine-runtime.cause: The managed PHP runtime, extension set, or PocketMine PHAR is missing, incomplete, or incompatible.
bedrock-pocketmine-runtime.fix: Use the panel's PocketMine software installer to restore its bundled runtime and official PHAR. Inspect the exact missing extension and install log; do not substitute an arbitrary system PHP binary.

bedrock-plugin-unsupported-software.error: Plugin installation is unsupported for this software / use PocketMine for Bedrock plugins
bedrock-plugin-unsupported-software.cause: Official Bedrock Dedicated Server supports behavior/resource packs, not PocketMine .phar plugins or Java .jar plugins.
bedrock-plugin-unsupported-software.fix: For official BDS, install compatible behavior/resource packs. If plugin APIs are required, select PocketMine-MP and confirm its feature differences; PocketMine is not full vanilla BDS parity.

panel-api-request-failed.error: Request failed / API returned HTTP 500 / Cannot GET or POST /api/...
panel-api-request-failed.cause: The route may be missing, the request method/payload may disagree with the backend, or a backend exception occurred.
panel-api-request-failed.fix: Capture the exact method, path, HTTP status, and first backend stack trace. Compare the frontend request with the registered route and return a structured error. Never expose credentials or session tokens in logs.

panel-live-view-stale.error: File manager or plugin list is stale until page refresh
panel-live-view-stale.cause: The mutation completed without invalidating or refreshing the corresponding live view state.
panel-live-view-stale.fix: After the operation succeeds, refresh the affected server-scoped listing or consume its live event, then reconcile with the filesystem as source of truth. Do not require a full-page reload or report success before the filesystem operation completes.

panel-live-progress-disappears.error: Progress disappears after one second / percentage never updates
panel-live-progress-disappears.cause: Progress lifecycle is tied to a short request/timeout instead of a persistent operation ID and terminal event.
panel-live-progress-disappears.fix: Track operation state by server and operation ID, report completed bytes or files where available, poll or stream updates, and dismiss only after success/failure reaches a terminal state. Do not invent percent precision when total work is unknown.

panel-console-command-duplicated.error: Console command duplicated / command appears twice in server log
panel-console-command-duplicated.cause: The frontend may submit through both form and key handlers, or a reconnect/retry may replay a non-idempotent command.
panel-console-command-duplicated.fix: Trace one submit from UI event to backend write, guard against duplicate in-flight request IDs, and do not automatically replay console commands after reconnect. Preserve legitimate server output instead of deleting repeated-looking log lines.

panel-section-refresh-route-lost.error: Panel route resets to dashboard after browser refresh
panel-section-refresh-route-lost.cause: The selected section is held only in transient UI state and is not restored from the URL or validated persisted navigation state.
panel-section-refresh-route-lost.fix: Encode the current section in the URL/history state, validate it against available sections and permissions at startup, then restore it after refresh. Do not bypass role/capability checks.

panel-console-session-duplicated.error: Duplicate console lines after reconnect / WebSocket or event stream reconnect
panel-console-session-duplicated.cause: The client resumes without a last-seen event cursor or the backend replays overlapping log buffers.
panel-console-session-duplicated.fix: Use monotonically increasing event IDs or timestamps with a stable cursor and deduplicate transport replay by event ID. Do not deduplicate separate identical messages emitted by the game.

panel-database-connection-failed.error: SQLITE_CANTOPEN / unable to open database file / database initialization failed
panel-database-connection-failed.cause: The configured DB path is unavailable, parent directory is not writable by the service identity, disk is full, or the database file is invalid.
panel-database-connection-failed.fix: Check the configured data root, service-user access, free disk space, and startup journal. Preserve the database and its WAL files before recovery; do not delete or recreate the production DB as a first step.

panel-database-migration-failed.error: Database migration failed / no such column / migration transaction rolled back
panel-database-migration-failed.cause: The database schema does not match the running code, or a migration failed partway through.
panel-database-migration-failed.fix: Stop duplicate panel instances, preserve a verified DB snapshot, and inspect the exact migration and schema version. Apply a supported forward migration or restore a matching backup; never drop user/server tables to silence the error.

panel-session-cookie-invalid.error: Session invalid / CSRF token mismatch / signed cookie verification failed
panel-session-cookie-invalid.cause: Cookie signing secret changed, cookies are stale, proxy HTTPS settings are inconsistent, or the request lacks the required CSRF header.
panel-session-cookie-invalid.fix: Check persistent cookie-secret configuration, proxy trust and HTTPS cookie settings, browser cookie scope, and CSRF header wiring. Keep the signing secret stable across restarts; do not reset or delete owner accounts to repair sessions.

panel-upload-session-expired.error: Upload session not found / committed ranges missing / checksum mismatch
panel-upload-session-expired.cause: The upload session or committed chunk manifest expired, was not persisted, or conflicts with the actual temporary file.
panel-upload-session-expired.fix: Compare the session ID, committed byte ranges, file size, and chunk hashes. Resume only from verified committed chunks; otherwise create a fresh upload and remove only its abandoned temporary artifact after confirming it is not active.

panel-plugin-inventory-stale.error: Plugin list still shows deleted plugin / installed state out of sync
panel-plugin-inventory-stale.cause: The plugin view is using stale cached metadata instead of reconciling with the server's active plugin directory.
panel-plugin-inventory-stale.fix: Rescan the correct plugins or mods directory after file mutations and derive installed state from matching files. Keep catalog search metadata separate from installed-file state; do not delete another plugin's data directory automatically.

panel-service-restart-data-missing.error: Users/servers missing after restart / panel appears to run first-time setup again
panel-service-restart-data-missing.cause: The service is using a different or ephemeral data root, wrong working directory, or a newly initialized database.
panel-service-restart-data-missing.fix: Inspect the service environment and resolved database path, then compare it with the existing production DB and backups. Restore the original configured data root; never initialize over or delete the old database until its contents are verified.

panel-permission-denied-route.error: 403 Forbidden / capability denied / permission map mismatch
panel-permission-denied-route.cause: The UI and API use different capability keys, or the route lacks the expected backend authorization check.
panel-permission-denied-route.fix: Use one capability definition for navigation and endpoint authorization, with backend enforcement authoritative. Verify both allowed and denied cases using a limited account; do not solve a 403 by disabling authorization.

panel-service-start-limit.error: Start request repeated too quickly / start-limit-hit
panel-service-start-limit.cause: A persistent startup error caused a restart loop and systemd rate limiting.
panel-service-start-limit.fix: Inspect the first failure in journalctl, correct the underlying issue, and only then clear the start limit and start once. Avoid increasing restart frequency or looping blindly.

process-port-held.error: Address already in use / bind failed / EADDRINUSE
process-port-held.cause: A running or stale game process, proxy, or other host service owns the socket. A panel allocation collision and an OS-level listener are separate conditions.
process-port-held.fix: Inspect the protocol and listener with an OS socket tool (Linux: ss -ltnup; Windows: Get-NetTCPConnection), identify its owning PID/service, and map it to a server before stopping anything. Stop only a confirmed stale process or assign a free compatible port. Never kill an unknown process.

world-session-lock-active.error: session.lock / World is already in use / Failed to lock level
world-session-lock-active.cause: Another active process may be writing the same world, or an old lock file may remain after an unclean shutdown.
world-session-lock-active.fix: First check the panel runtime status and OS process list for every process using that server root. If any process is active, stop it gracefully and do not delete the lock. Only when no process can access the world, preserve a backup and remove a confirmed stale session lock before one controlled start. Never run two servers against the same world.

duplicate-server-process.error: Server process already exists / another instance is running / PID still active
duplicate-server-process.cause: The runtime may have a stale PID record, a live child that lost its panel connection, or a duplicate external launch.
duplicate-server-process.fix: Compare the tracked PID with the OS process command line, server root, and transient systemd unit. Reattach/reconcile a valid live process; clear stale tracking only after verifying the process is gone. Do not launch a second writer or kill a PID based only on a stale status label.

server-file-busy.error: EBUSY / resource busy / sharing violation / file is in use by another process
server-file-busy.cause: The active game process, archive/backup worker, or another host process has an open handle; some filesystems also report transient busy errors during writes.
server-file-busy.fix: Identify the operation and owning process, wait for active writes or stop the server cleanly, then retry. For world/database files, take an offline verified backup before repair. Do not force-delete an open world, LevelDB, SQLite, or backup file.

support-config-json-missing.error: whitelist.json / allowlist.json / permissions.json not found or JSON parse failed
support-config-json-missing.cause: A first install omitted the default file, or an interrupted edit left malformed JSON.
support-config-json-missing.fix: For a missing file, create the documented empty-list default. For malformed content, first preserve the original in config-recovery, then rebuild only that known support file. Never reset a valid list.

bedrock-missing-pack-reference.error: Pack UUID not found / missing behavior or resource pack / pack stack missing
bedrock-missing-pack-reference.cause: The pack was removed or moved, or its manifest no longer matches the world reference.
bedrock-missing-pack-reference.fix: Only while the server is offline, back up the world's reference JSON and compare UUID/version values to installed manifests. Remove only references proven missing; retain and restore any pack required by the world. Never delete world data.

archive-incomplete.error: Unexpected end of archive / truncated ZIP / stale .download or .uploading file
archive-incomplete.cause: A transfer was interrupted, or a partial artifact was left after a failed operation.
archive-incomplete.fix: Check that no upload/archive job is active and that the partial file is older than the active-operation window. Remove only confirmed stale partial artifacts, then retry or resume from verified chunks. Never remove a valid archive or backup.

server-root-readonly.error: Server root not writable / write test failed / permission denied under server root
server-root-readonly.cause: Ownership or ACLs for the dedicated server identity are incorrect, or the filesystem is read-only.
server-root-readonly.fix: Run the scoped permission auditor and repair only the affected server-root paths for that server identity. If the mount is read-only or storage has I/O errors, stop and repair the host filesystem instead of changing permissions. Never use chmod 777 or widen access to other tenants.
